data.one_liner: Provides a floating bottom navigation bar with a sliding animation and center action button.
data.what_it_does: This package provides a custom bottom navigation bar widget with sliding animations for a floating action button located at the center and bottom tab buttons. It allows configuring multiple tab items, center button actions, and initial indexes using a controller.
use_when: You need a floating bottom navigation bar with custom center button animations.
You want to display animated tab items with customizable icons, titles, and dot colors.
avoid_when: You require a standard Material BottomNavigationBar without custom floating animations.
You need an advanced layout that goes beyond the provided AnimatedBottomNavigationBar parameters.
strengths: Includes built-in sliding animations for the bottom bar items and center button.
Supports custom center button child options and item selection states.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on all available styling options.
No explicit alternatives from the catalog list that perform the exact same floating bottom bar function.
data.minimal_example:
bottomNavigationBar: AnimatedBottomNavigationBar(
  barColor: Colors.white,
  controller: FloatingBottomBarController(initialIndex: 1),
  bottomBar: [
    BottomBarItem(
      icon: const Icon(Icons.home),
      iconSelected: const Icon(Icons.home, color: Colors.red),
      title: 'Home',
      dotColor: Colors.red,
      onTap: (value) {},
    ),
  ],
  bottomBarCenterModel: BottomBarCenterModel(
    centerBackgroundColor: Colors.red,
    centerIcon: const FloatingCenterButton(
      child: Icon(Icons.add, color: Colors.white),
    ),
    centerIconChild: [],
  ),
)
